# Resomix

> Resomix finds music by how it sounds, not how it is tagged. The PYXIS-1 engine builds a sonic
> profile for each recording so a catalogue can be searched by reference rather than by metadata.

Resomix is a sonic intelligence platform for the electronic music industry. Upload or pick a
reference track and it returns ranked matches that genuinely belong next to it; analyse a single
recording; or make an authorised catalogue searchable by sound.

## Product

- [Product overview](https://resomix.com/product): Search, similarity and track analysis in one place.
- [Sonic Discovery](https://resomix.com/product/sonic-discovery): Reference-based discovery — one track in, ranked matches out.
- [Track Intelligence](https://resomix.com/product/track-intelligence): Tempo, key, energy and sonic character read from the audio.
- [Catalogue Intelligence](https://resomix.com/product/catalog-intelligence): Authorised catalogues profiled into a partner-scoped sonic index.
